follow-up time: To primary school age (mean age 8.2 years)
study type: prospective multicentre observational birth cohort study
cohort: 5,572 children from the EuroPrevall-iFAAM birth cohort study, recruited at birth in 8 European study centres
finding: Family history of allergies, early-life allergy symptoms, and caesarean birth were identified as risk factors for allergic multimorbidity in European primary school children.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with an increased risk of allergic multimorbidity.
